description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication functionalities such as register, login, request OTP, and verify OTP. It uses an authController for implementing route logic and includes Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration requests, creating a new user and returning a JWT on success.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login requests, authenticating user credentials and returning a JWT.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Handles OTP request, generates and stores a mocked OTP.

methods.name: verifyOtp
methods.description: Verifies a mocked OTP and issues a JWT upon successful verification.
